But British female track success in 2025 certainly didn't stop there. Sprinter Amy Hunt made headlines with a record four-gold display in the Europeans in Birmingham, while Dina Asher-Smith now tops the all-time medal table at the championships after winning her 11th, eight of which are gold. metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team held 'huge discussions' over strategy following Bahrain GP tyre-choice blunder | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team held 'huge discussions' over strategy following Bahrain GP tyre-choice blunder Lewis Hamilton plummeted from second on the grid after starting last weekend's Bahrain GP on slick dry tyres in wet conditions; watch Practice at 9.30am followed by Sprint Qualifying at 1.30pm on Friday live on Sky Sports F1 as the Singapore Grand Prix weekend begins Thursday 8 October 2026 15:06, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Following criticisms at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, Lewis Hamilton defends Ferrari strategists Lewis Hamilton has revealed Ferrari held a "huge discussion" to reflect on a strategic error at the Bahrain Grand Prix that he says "wasn't good enough". Ferrari fitted both Hamilton and his team-mate Charles Leclerc with slick dry tyres at last weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix, which was being hosted in Malaysia and started on a wet track that the Italian squad anticipated would quickly dry out once the race began. The decision was proven wrong as Hamilton fell from his starting position of second to almost the back of the field in the opening stages, with the 14 of 22 drivers that started on the intermediate tyre gaining a huge advantage. On Wednesday, it was announced that Eckert has been handed a six-week ban, suspended until the end of the 2027/28 season, and fined £28,000 after admitting three FA charges relating to misconduct during Southampton's spying scandal. He will continue in his role and is now focused on Sunday's Championship clash with local rivals Portsmouth.
